scope: Complete independent block-local scalar research packet. It serializes templates, row selectors, model metadata and all values, proves exact decode, and charges a 32-byte header plus 32-byte directory entries. It is not a VXG v3 wire format or a codec GB/s benchmark.
selection_rule: For each raw block, build RAW and grammar packets and select grammar only when it is strictly shorter. For every grammar column, choose the shortest of raw, canonical byte dictionary, canonical decimal affine, quoted fixed-width lowercase-hex suffix, quoted hex epoch-counter, quoted semicolon segment dictionary, quoted same-year ISO-8601 and the retained periodic/GF(2) models; ties retain raw/earlier model order. No model reads a field name, source path, seed or external state.
